newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates continue to mellow.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates continue to mellow.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rate (PHIBOR) continued its slide on Tuesday, prompted by high liquidity in the market, traders said. Only the three-month rate was unchanged.
The adjustment in rates also followed the decline in T-bill rates on Monday, they said.
"It might flatten at these levels meanwhile. The Central Bank has decided to lie low," a foreign bank dealer said.

The Central Bank is not expected to lower its rates further to prevent peso speculation, traders said. Last Friday, the Central Bank dropped its key overnight borrowing rate by 0.25 percentage point to 10 percent.
